model.purpose: Pinned identity for later authoritative analysis; hardware timing does not calculate quality metrics.

storagePreparationAdjustment.scope: Storage-only preparation; no source, cell, order, seed, rate-control, warmup, repetition or stability criterion changed.
storagePreparationAdjustment.before: Mac staged one source at a time because only approximately 8 GiB was available.
storagePreparationAdjustment.now: All seven exact registered references were staged and SHA/size verified before hardware timing, preserving more than 5 GiB free; P910 coordinator was paused during transfers.

Mac.identityProof: All 102 local helper/dependency bytes checked during preparation, plus embedded Mac package audit; execution checks them again.
Mac.remainingGate: AC power and valid observed environment; current parent allocation before first encode.

P910.identityProof: Existing Linux939 package archive audit pins filtered lock and helper bytes; live hashes deferred until allocated execution preflight.
P910.remainingGate: Stage the exact archive after current capacity/native acceptance phases, obtain current parent timing allocation, and run live identity/environment guards.
